conservation.report_notes: Published with corresponding artwork entry in *Georgia O’Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné* (Lynes, 1999), this historical conservation information documents treatment decisions made during the artist’s lifetime. Lynes quotes information found on backing labels, and, when noted, from other sources.

cr_data.provenance: (The Downtown Gallery, New York, NY); Private collection, New York, NY, 1952; Hirschl & Adler Galleries, Inc., New York, NY, 1990 (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Abiquiú Notebooks indicates, "Exam. at Amer. Place, March 1946. . . . No signature. Nothing on back. This was in 1937–38 exh. at Amer. Place, see gallery photograph" [photograph not verified]. Title given by Rosalind Irvine." Abiquiú Notebooks after 1977 indicates, "Sold by Halpert, May 1952." (Source: Lynes, 1999)
